title: Judge Advocate General's Corps officer career pamphlet, DA PAM 600-3 chapter (27 February 2019)
proponent: The Judge Advocate General's Legal Center and School (JAG Corps proponent)
dateBasis: printed in the running title. An older chapter; the Army G-1 page lists it as current (uploaded 8 Aug 2022).
limitations: The run imported is the Major, Lieutenant Colonel and Colonel development text for judge advocates; company grade officers are described in a different part of the chapter and are not imported. Applies to 27A; the military judge AOC (27B) is not covered.
